name: AI Router Safety Checklist
description_md:
Review an AI router before giving your agent access to business data and tools.

Checklist: Provider, data access, credentials, command review and recovery checks. Review prompt: A copyable request for a read-only assessment of your setup. Evidence: The research paper behind the reel, with its scope clearly stated.

Free Markdown checklist in a ZIP. An operational review aid, not a security certification or tested defense implementation.
